title: Subsidence Advisory NSW
summary: This page provides information about subsidence in NSW, including advisory services and resources for property owners.

external_links.text: Subsidence Advisory NSW Portal - NSW Government

internal_links.text: Property in a mine subsidence district

faqs.a: Subsidence is the gradual sinking or settling of the ground surface. It can be caused by various factors, including mining activities.

faqs.q: Where can I find more information about subsidence?
faqs.a: You can find more information on the Subsidence Advisory NSW Portal.

faqs.q: What should I do if my property is in a mine subsidence district?
faqs.a: If your property is in a mine subsidence district, you should check the specific guidelines and resources available for that area.
